case_title: JUAN DE JESUS SALGADO MEZA VS. LGD INC

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY SALGADO MEZA, JUAN DE JESUS AS TO DEFENDANT LGD INC DBA EUR-ASIA MOTORS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-14-2020 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$40.00) SERVED JUL-07-2020, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT LGD INC DBA EUR-ASIA MOTORS
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) ROLANDO HERNANDEZ, SALES MANAGER FILED BY DEFENDANT LGD INC DBA EUR-ASIA MOTORS

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-14-2020 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF JUAN DE JESUS SALGADO MEZA, ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPERTER DANIEL NAVARRO #300802 IS PRESENT. MELISSA ANDERSON, PLANTIFF'S DAUGHTER IN LAW TESTIFIES ON PLAINTIFF'S BEHALF. DEFENDANT LGD INC, REPRESENTED BY ROLANDO HERNANDEZ, SALES MANAGER IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SALGADO MEZA, JUAN DE JESUS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LGD INC DBA EUR-ASIA MOTORS $1,600.00 PRINCIPAL, $115.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,715.00, DEFENDANT LGD INC., SHALL RELEASE THE DMV LIEN ON PLAINTIFF JUAN DE JESUS SALGADO MEZA'S VEHICLE AND RETURN THE VEHICLE UPON DEMAND. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
